rapport_notes: Friendly, conversational tone with good acknowledgments ('Mm-hmm,' 'Cool'), though slightly rushed given the customer's time constraint.
process_discipline_notes: Damage coverage ($2,000) mentioned in Stage 1 ('wrap all the furniture, everything's insured') and then repeated in Stage 2 ('no worries damage covers... up to $2,000 per move').

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Calvin: 'I was reaching out, I got the quote request for Tuesday September 22nd so kind of coming right up. Wondering if you had maybe about ten minutes or so to go through the move.' — frames time but does not frame the trade (benefit of an accurate quote in return); later says 'our best bet on getting the most accurate quote would be kind of a virtual walkthrough' but this comes after probing has started.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Calvin: 'on your side is there anything at this moment that you're like in particular early, you know, most concerned about for the move.' — asked after Calvin has already probed about partial move, furniture details, and bedroom count.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer: 'Not that, I can think of.' — no concern raised by customer; per rubric, no follow-up gap can exist. Item #3 receives N/A/full credit.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Stage 1: 'we do, you know, wrap all the furniture, everything's insured.' Stage 2 (repeat): 'we have our no worries damage covers it's just higher evaluation for your items we okay, up to $2,000 per move.'
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: Not covered anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Calvin: 'we do have an on time guarantee if we're ever late we do discount you money back.'
evidence_quotes.communication: Not covered anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Calvin: 'we maintain a $2.05 hour minimum... we bill in fifteen minute increments.' Partial — gives minimum and increment but does not provide a typical range for this move type (3BR partial, 2-man crew, 1 trip) or personalize to the customer's specific items.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: Calvin: 'billing in fifteen minute increments, so you just pay for time needed' and later 'if the crew beats it' implied in 'you just pay for time needed'.
evidence_quotes.close: No rate-lock line ('your rate locks when you book') and no explicit ask ('would you like our help with your move?'). Call ends with 'if anything pops up shoot us an email or give us a call I'll get this emailed over to you.'

top_strength: Calvin handled the partial-move discovery cleanly, asked clarifying questions about furniture and special items, and correctly routed the customer to a virtual walkthrough—the right decision for a move where accuracy matters and time is tight.
coaching_note: Ask the customer's agenda (concerns + what they want answered) *before* diving into logistics probing, and then dig at least one layer deeper on whatever they raise; also, do not repeat differentiators (damage coverage appeared twice) and always close with a rate-lock line and an explicit ask, even on walkthrough-routed calls.
